_comment: Retired 11 Nov 2026: K26 is official and sworn in. The GitHub k26-refresh schedule trigger is removed and auto is false, so neither it nor any Netlify k26 function (already unscheduled in netlify.toml) will rebuild anything; a forced manual workflow run (force=true) still bypasses this gate for a one-off rebuild. nowcast_model: which transfer model the count centre opens with for every visitor -- 'abs' = with non-voters (default), 'plain' = without non-voters.
